pages.text: Ashen Spires are a common sight in Coalification biomes and look similar to tendrils emerging from the ground. Although the Spires are rather inert, they can still be useful as lantern holders. Simply use a lantern on the top half of them to hang it. Ashen Spires can be crafted by using two Ashen Remains. A Hoe can also be used to change what directiong the Spires face.
Walking through Ashen Spires can tickle a bit.
